_note: Starter knowledge base. General, durable descriptions only — no amounts, dates or promises. Replace or extend with your campaign's verified material through /api/knowledge before field use.

documents.title: PM-KISAN income support
documents.body: Central scheme paying land-holding farmer families direct income support in instalments to their bank account. Instalments commonly stop because e-KYC is incomplete, the bank account is not Aadhaar-seeded, or land records do not match.
documents.ask: Ask whether PM-KISAN instalments are arriving; if they stopped, note whether e-KYC or bank seeding is pending so the help desk can follow up.
documents.source: Scheme overview (verify current rules with the agriculture department)

documents.title: Free ration under the food security scheme
documents.body: Eligible ration-card households receive foodgrains through fair-price shops. Common problems: names missing from the card, biometric authentication failures at the shop, short supply.
documents.ask: Ask whether the family receives its full ration each month and whether every member is on the ration card.

documents.title: Housing scheme (PMAY / PMAY-G)
documents.body: Housing assistance is released in instalments linked to construction stages, with geo-tagged photos at each stage. Delays usually come from pending geo-tagging or stage verification.
documents.ask: Ask how the house built under the housing scheme is working out and whether any instalment is still pending.

documents.title: Ujjwala LPG connections
documents.body: Provides LPG connections to eligible households. Usage depends on refill affordability and distributor access.
documents.ask: Check whether the Ujjwala gas connection is in use and whether refills are easy to get.

documents.title: Ayushman Bharat health cover
documents.body: Health insurance cover for eligible families at empanelled hospitals. Each member needs an Ayushman card; enrolment drives and Common Service Centres can issue cards.
documents.ask: Ask whether every family member has an Ayushman card and offer to help those without one find the next enrolment camp.

documents.title: Checking names and polling booths
documents.body: Voters can check their name, polling station and serial number on the Election Commission's Voters' Services Portal or the Voter Helpline app, or by calling 1950.
documents.ask: Confirm each member knows their polling booth and serial number; offer to look it up on the Voter Helpline app.
documents.source: Election Commission of India voter services

documents.title: Home voting for elderly and disabled voters
documents.body: The Election Commission allows voters above 85 and persons with benchmark disabilities to opt for voting from home by applying in advance through their booth level officer, within the notified window.
documents.ask: If an elder (85+) or a voter with a disability lives here, ask whether they want help applying for home voting through the booth level officer.
documents.source: Election Commission of India (check the notified window for this election)

documents.title: First-time voters
documents.body: Young people who have turned 18 can enrol using Form 6 on the Voters' Services Portal. Enrolment closes before polling, as notified.
documents.ask: Ask young members whether they are enrolled; help anyone who has turned 18 start Form 6.

documents.title: Members working away from home
documents.body: Voters are registered at their ordinary residence and must vote in person at their own booth. Overseas electors registered in India can vote only in person at their booth.
documents.ask: Ask whether members working elsewhere plan to be home on polling day, and note their travel plans.

documents.title: Uttar Pradesh field context
documents.body: Households often depend on welfare delivery (ration, housing, PM-KISAN). Western UP has many sugarcane farmers who track mill payment timeliness; stray cattle damage to crops is a common rural complaint.
documents.ask: Ask which government service matters most to the family right now and whether it is reaching them.

documents.title: Sugarcane payments
documents.body: Cane growers sell to assigned sugar mills; delays in mill payments and the season's cane price are recurring concerns.
documents.ask: Ask cane-growing families whether this season's mill payments have arrived on time.

documents.title: Stray cattle and crop damage
documents.body: Farmers report crop damage from stray cattle and the cost of guarding fields at night.
documents.ask: Ask farming families whether stray cattle have damaged crops this season.

documents.title: Punjab field context
documents.body: An agrarian state: procurement at the mandi, input costs and groundwater are central. Many families have members abroad. Drug abuse among youth is a widely raised concern.
documents.ask: Ask what the family's biggest concern is this season: crops, jobs or something else.

documents.title: Mandi procurement
documents.body: Wheat and paddy are procured at mandis; farmers watch procurement speed, moisture norms and payment timing.
documents.ask: Ask how procurement at the mandi went this season and whether payment came on time.

documents.title: Groundwater and crop diversification
documents.body: Falling water tables raise pumping costs; diversification away from paddy is often discussed.
documents.ask: Ask whether falling groundwater or electricity for pumps is affecting the farm.

documents.title: Old-age pension (Punjab)
documents.body: State old-age pension is paid monthly to eligible elders; delays are often due to bank account or life-certificate issues.
documents.ask: Check whether the elder's pension is being credited regularly.

documents.title: Uttarakhand field context
documents.body: Hill households face long distances to roads, schools and health centres, and many young people migrate for work. Many families have ex-servicemen.
documents.ask: Ask how far the family has to travel for a health centre or school, and whether the road holds up in the monsoon.

documents.title: Out-migration from hill villages
documents.body: Young people leave for jobs in the plains; families ask about local livelihoods, tourism and homestays.
documents.ask: Ask whether young people in the family have had to move away for work, and what would help them stay.

documents.title: Ex-servicemen families
documents.body: Ex-servicemen raise pension, ECHS health facility and canteen access issues.
documents.ask: Thank ex-servicemen for their service and ask about any pension or ECHS problem to pass on.

documents.title: Goa field context
documents.body: Small, close-knit wards where family and neighbourhood ties matter. Livelihoods depend on tourism, services, fishing and, in some areas, mining. Water supply and garbage collection are frequent ward-level issues.
documents.ask: Ask about ward-level problems like water supply, garbage collection or road repair.

documents.title: Griha Aadhar
documents.body: Goa state scheme giving monthly financial support to eligible homemakers; credits can lapse if documents are not renewed.
documents.ask: Ask whether the Griha Aadhar support is being credited and whether any renewal is pending.

documents.title: DSSS pension
documents.body: Goa's social security pension for senior citizens and other eligible groups, paid monthly.
documents.ask: Check that the DSSS pension reaches the elder without delay.

documents.title: Fishing families
documents.body: Fishing families are affected by the annual monsoon fishing ban and jetty facilities.
documents.ask: Ask fishing families how they manage through the fishing-ban months and what jetty facilities they need.

documents.title: Mining-dependent livelihoods
documents.body: Families who depended on mining look for livelihood support and clarity on the resumption of mining.
documents.ask: Ask mining-dependent families what livelihood support would help them most.
